text: Cool air, dripping stone, the ordinary dark of an ordinary cave. Until the old sword at Kai's hip goes warm against his leg.

speaker: Kai
text: That's — that's new. Swords aren't supposed to do that. This one's never done that.
Faint lines of light surface along the blade, like writing waking up. Ahead, the cave wall — not a wall. A seam. It splits, slow and soundless, and opens. Not because he pushed it. Because he's here.

speaker: Kai
text: ...okay. I've read enough stories to know this is the part where a smart person leaves.

speaker: Kai
text: Never claimed to be a smart person.

Beyond the door: a chamber that no forager built. And at its heart a stone hangs in the air, unsupported, ringed in slow runic light that is not firelight and not daylight and not anything he has a word for.

speaker: Kai
text: It's just... waiting. Like it's been waiting a very long time.
He reaches out. Of course he reaches out.
The light does not answer gently.
